resources.name: Orange County Rescue Mission
resources.description: One of OC's largest shelter and recovery networks. Village of Hope offers emergency shelter, meals, showers, and long-term recovery programs.
resources.eligibility: Men, women, families; some programs require sobriety

resources.name: Illumination Foundation
resources.description: Emergency shelter, recuperative care for medically fragile unhoused people, and family housing placement across OC.

resources.name: Mercy House
resources.description: Emergency shelter, transitional housing, and homeless prevention across OC.

resources.name: Bridges at Kraemer Place
resources.description: Orange County's year-round 200-bed emergency shelter for single adults with on-site services and housing navigation.
resources.eligibility: Single adults; referral through Coordinated Entry (211)

resources.name: WISEPlace
resources.description: Emergency shelter and transitional housing for single women without custody of children — one of few OC options for this group.

resources.name: Colette's Children's Home
resources.description: Emergency and transitional housing for homeless women and children with job support.

resources.name: Grandma's House of Hope
resources.description: Shelter and services for homeless women, including women with pets and women fleeing violence — populations most shelters turn away.

resources.name: Friendship Shelter
resources.description: Shelter and housing navigation for single adults experiencing homelessness in south OC.

resources.name: Families Forward
resources.description: Housing, food, counseling, and case management for families at risk of homelessness.

resources.name: Pathways of Hope
resources.description: Shelter, housing, and food for families and individuals in north OC.

resources.name: Family Assistance Ministries (FAM)
resources.description: Shelter, food, and supportive services for women, families, and veterans in south OC.

resources.name: Homeless Intervention Services of Orange County (HIS-OC)
resources.description: Transitional housing, emergency shelter, and supportive services in north OC.

resources.name: Isaiah House — Orange County Catholic Worker
resources.description: Small donation-run hospitality house offering shelter, meals, showers, and laundry. Runs on donations, not grants.

resources.name: The Eli Home
resources.description: Emergency shelter for abused children and their mothers.

resources.name: Casa Teresa
resources.description: Long-term shelter and support for pregnant women and mothers in crisis.

resources.name: Mary's Shelter
resources.description: Housing and education for homeless single pregnant and parenting women.

resources.name: Thomas House Family Shelter
resources.description: Transitional shelter program for homeless families.

resources.name: Someone Cares Soup Kitchen
resources.description: Free hot meals served daily, no questions asked. Also tutors kids living in motels.
resources.hours: Daily meals; check site for current times

resources.name: Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County
resources.description: OC's central food bank. Doesn't hand out food at the warehouse — find partner pantries and mobile distributions via the website or 211.

resources.name: Community Action Partnership of Orange County (CAPOC)
resources.description: Runs the OC Food Bank and utility bill assistance (LIHEAP).

resources.name: Salvation Army Orange County
resources.description: Hospitality House emergency shelter, meals, showers, and family services.

resources.name: CSP Youth Shelter — Community Service Programs
resources.description: Emergency shelter for runaway and homeless youth, plus outpatient counseling.

resources.name: Casa Youth Shelter
resources.description: Emergency shelter and counseling for youth ages 12-17 in crisis. Open 24 hours.

resources.name: Orangewood Foundation
resources.description: Transitional housing, education vouchers, and life-skills support for current and former foster youth in OC.

resources.name: StandUp for Kids — Orange County
resources.description: Street outreach, food, and mentoring for homeless and at-risk youth.

resources.name: Project Hope Alliance
resources.description: Keeps homeless children and youth enrolled in school; also helps families with housing.

resources.name: City Net
resources.description: Street outreach and Coordinated Entry assessments across OC. They will meet people where they are.

resources.name: Laura's House
resources.description: Emergency DV shelter, transitional housing, counseling, and legal advocacy for domestic violence survivors.

resources.name: Human Options
resources.description: 24/7 DV crisis line, emergency shelter, and counseling services.

resources.name: Interval House
resources.description: 24/7 DV crisis line and one of the largest DV shelter organizations, serving OC.
